explanation: The tea bushes are shaded for several weeks before harvest, which deepens their green colour. Drinkers whisk the powder into hot water, so they swallow the whole leaf.

claims.text: Matcha is finely ground powder made from green tea leaves.
Matcha is not made from mint, bamboo or moringa leaves.
Tea plants grown for matcha are shaded for several weeks before harvest, which deepens the leaves' green colour.
Matcha is whisked into hot water, so the drinker consumes the whole ground leaf.
